==Biography==
After departing from Manila Eagles, he was acquired by [[Mineski]] along with former Manila Eagles member [[Snoy]]. He played in the Riot Season 3 World Finals with [[Mineski]]. On October 10, 2013, he left [[Mineski]]. 

== Trivia ==
* Represented Philippines in WCG 2011
* First summoner name was Ezreal
* He was the number 1 solo queue rank player during Season 1
* Kaigu is known to eat donuts before, during, and after every game.
* Speaks English fluently
